system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: smam_generate_otp and smam_cancel_application. For your information, my mobile_number is 9876585238, my application_id is SMAM-APP-30000001, my aadhaar_number is 100020004019.

function.name: smam_cancel_application
function.description: Cancels SMAM application. Only when 'submitted' or 'under_review'. Requires session_token. Fails if already approved or purchase completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: smam_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for SMAM subsidy authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.
